finding.summary: The 'post' node calls runtime.context.publish and returns {} with no idempotency marker in the state. The graph is explicitly built checkpoint-ready (checkpointer parameter, results-only state), so once resume wiring lands (PMAT-266) a replay that re-enters after 'post' but before END — or a retry after publish succeeded but the super-step commit failed — will double-post the review comment. The PR context acknowledges this, but nothing in the code or tests guards it now.
finding.fix: Record a 'posted' flag (or the report hash) in ReviewState before/after publishing and make post a no-op when it is already set, or exclude the post node from replay until durable posting with an idempotency key exists; add a test that re-invoking the graph after 'post' does not call publish twice.

label: false_positive
